column1: # uri acceptance vectors, from RFC 3986 examples.
# A uri is an absolute URI, so it must carry a scheme (RFC 3986 §3). The
# scheme-less reference forms are the rejected rows. The official suite's
# optional/format/uri.json covers the character rules and carries the ftp and
# mailto examples verbatim. What it leaves open are the two RFC 3986 §5.4
# references that carry a scheme, which TestURIReferenceResolutionVectors hands
# over here because a relative-ref cannot begin with one. The RFC 3986 §1.1.2
# rows below restate suite cases, kept so the scheme rules read whole in one
# Row format: see loadVectorFile in vectors_test.go.
